allowed_inputs: generated non-private image and video fixtures
allowed_actions: start and stop existing local services
query public ComfyUI registry and local Ollama model inventory
run one-image and bounded four-frame feasibility probes
record redacted hashes, versions, timing, resource and cleanup evidence
scope.cleanup: Stop only processes started by this run and remove only run-owned temporary files.

explicitly_not_authorized: download or upgrade software or model weights
change Prompt Assistant, ComfyUI, Ollama or system configuration
read browser cookies or unrelated private directories
invoke cloud or paid model providers
push Git commits to a remote

git_identity.scope: local repository configuration and local commits

source: Direct user authorization in the active project conversation.
